claims.text: Aspirin 81 mg + ticagrelor: possibly beneficial in clopidogrel resistance (CYP2C19 loss-of-function allele), esp w an extracranial or intracranial stent.
claims.quote: Dual antiplatelet therapy with aspirin 81 mg and ticagrelor (possibly beneficial for patients with clopidogrel resistance CYP2C19 loss of function allele, especially if an extracranial or intracranial stent is used)
